01 DESKTOP HOME · compact launch, optional depth
02 PHONE GAME · focus on the question
Five questions. Four choices. Your next good break.
Play a clearly labelled practice bot, straight away.
ONE TAP TO PLAY · NO SIGNUP · ZERO STAKE
Send a link. Settle it on the scorecard.
A quick single before the full five.
Explore sports, science and answer sources.
Practice records stay on this device. Human standings belong to live matches.

No ads or navigation while answering.
03 ROUTE MAP · five purpose groups, existing records preserved
01 / First tap starts practice. Human consent stays explicit.
02 / 44 px controls, readable question type, visible keyboard focus.
03 / No ads during countdown, questions, search or answer review.
04 / Reduced motion; no shifting answer targets; source-backed feedback.
Warm paper / cricket ink / vermilion seam.
Risograph illustration lives on the launch surface.
Game UI recedes around the question.
